title: Payment Connector Pool Exhaustion
probable_cause: Payment connector pool exhaustion caused by downstream response latency and elevated database connection pressure.
recommended_action: Validate downstream gateway health, drain affected connector instances, and perform a controlled connector restart after approval.

title: Order Database Connection Saturation
probable_cause: Long-running transactions or connector churn consume the available database connection pool.
recommended_action: Identify long-running transactions, validate pool sizing, and recycle affected application connections after approval.

title: Order Queue Consumer Backlog
probable_cause: Consumer throughput is below producer rate, causing queue depth and downstream processing delay.
recommended_action: Validate producer rate, consumer health, partition balance, and recent consumer configuration changes before scaling consumers.

title: Accounting Consumer Batch Misconfiguration
probable_cause: An aggressive batch-size or poll-interval setting can increase retry volume and consumer lag.
recommended_action: Compare the active consumer configuration with the approved baseline and roll back only after dependency validation.

title: Legacy Payment Gateway TLS Timeout
probable_cause: Legacy TLS negotiation issue on a retired gateway endpoint.
recommended_action: Use the retired endpoint TLS workaround.

title: Unverified Queue Restart Procedure
probable_cause: Unknown; procedure assumes broker process instability.
recommended_action: Restart all queue brokers immediately and bypass change approval.

title: Enterprise Gateway TLS Inspection Disrupts Long-Lived Sessions
probable_cause: Expanded TLS inspection scope at the enterprise secure web gateway interrupts long-lived authenticated sessions and real-time signalling to external SaaS services.
recommended_action: Confirm vendor service health, identify the shared gateway dependency, and roll back or narrow the inspection policy after approval.

title: External SaaS Provider Service Degradation
probable_cause: A vendor-side outage or degradation at the SaaS provider disrupts enterprise access to that platform.
recommended_action: Confirm vendor service health from an authoritative source, activate continuity communications, and avoid internal remediation while the vendor is degraded.

title: Enterprise Runner Pool Exhaustion
probable_cause: Self-hosted runner capacity is exhausted, stalling workflows that require enterprise-hosted runners while vendor-hosted paths remain healthy.
recommended_action: Inspect runner availability and capacity, then scale or recycle the affected pool after approval.
